title: IT helpdesk contact
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - IT to confirm.
Email the helpdesk or raise a ticket in the service portal. Include your employee ID and a screenshot.

title: How to raise a support ticket and SLA
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - IT to confirm.
1. Open the service portal.
2. Choose a category (Access, Hardware, Software).
3. P1 issues answered in 4 business hours, others in 2 business days.

title: VPN setup
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - IT to confirm.
Install the VPN client from the software centre and sign in with your corporate account.

title: Email and Slack
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - IT to confirm.
Created automatically before your start date. Slack workspace invite arrives by email on day one.

title: Jira and GitHub access
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - IT to confirm.
Request via the service portal under 'Access > Engineering tools'. Your manager approves the request.

title: Payroll contact
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - HR to confirm.
Questions about salary, bank details or payslips go to payroll.

title: Leave policy and holiday calendar
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - HR to confirm.
Apply for leave in the HR portal. The holiday calendar for the year is published there too.

title: Benefits
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - HR to confirm.
Benefits enrolment opens in your first week; see the HR portal for health cover details.

title: Office timings and seating
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - Facilities to confirm.
Core hours 10:00-16:00. Hot desks are booked through the workplace app.

title: ID cards and reimbursement
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - Facilities to confirm.
Collect your ID card at reception on day one. Submit expense claims in the finance portal within 30 days.

title: Code of conduct
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - HR to confirm.
Read and acknowledge the code of conduct in your first week.

title: Data handling policy
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER - Security to confirm.
Never share customer data outside approved tools. Report suspected incidents to security immediately.

title: Who do I ask for what?
body_md:
PLACEHOLDER
- Laptop or access problems: IT helpdesk
- Pay, leave, benefits: HR / payroll
- Desk, ID card: Facilities
- Your tasks and priorities: your manager
